title: Causal Generalization of Continuous Treatment Effects under Covariate Shift
abstract: arXiv:2608.19383v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Average dose-response functions are widely used to summarize causal effects of continuous treatments, but most existing methods assume that the observed sample represents the target population. We study a covariate-shift setting in which covariates, treatment, and outcome are observed in a labelled source sample, while only covariates are observed in the target sample. We develop a two-sample local polynomial regression framework based on pseudo-outcomes that use source outcomes to address confounding and target covariates to define the population of interest. We further propose a source-to-target extension of distance covariance optimal weighting (DCOW), designed to remove treatment-covariate dependence in the source sample while aligning the weighted source covariate distribution with the target population. translated_title: 协变量偏移下连续治疗效应的因果泛化
translated_abstract: 平均剂量-反应函数广泛用于总结连续治疗的因果效应，但大多数现有方法假设观测样本代表目标人群。我们研究了一个协变量偏移场景，其中协变量、治疗和结果在标记的源样本中观测到，而目标样本中仅观测到协变量。我们开发了一个基于伪结果的两样本局部多项式回归框架，该框架利用源结果来处理混杂，并利用目标协变量来定义感兴趣的人群。我们进一步提出了一种源到目标的距离协方差最优加权（DCOW）扩展，旨在去除源样本中的治疗-协变量依赖性，同时将加权后的源协变量分布与目标人群对齐。一个核心的理论贡献是对这种基于优化的程序进行权重层面的分析：我们证明了总体层面的性质。
tldr: 本文提出了一种在协变量偏移下估计连续治疗因果效应的新方法，通过伪结果和源到目标DCOW加权，实现了对目标人群的因果泛化。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a novel method for estimating causal effects of continuous treatments under covariate shift, using pseudo-outcomes and source-to-target DCOW weighting to achieve causal generalization to the target population.
